description: This PHP script handles API requests related to test case management in the TestLink open-source test management system. It processes incoming request parameters, validates API keys, verifies user permissions, extracts test case identifiers, retrieves specific test case versions from the database, and redirects to the test case print page.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: Represents a user within the TestLink system, with methods to retrieve user data by API key and to check user permissions.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: Handles operations related to test case data, such as retrieving internal test case IDs and version IDs.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main function that processes API requests: validates API key, checks user rights, extracts test case info, retrieves test case versions, and redirects to the test case print page.
